answer: A newcomer to the consortium must be sponsored by an existing member who stakes its own reputation and a bond on the newcomer's good behavior, and the sponsorship is recorded publicly. A Sybil farm that tries to onboard fifty fake members needs fifty real sponsors willing to risk their bonds, because the vault of the sponsor's stake is on the line, and the wharf of the onboarding check turns away any newcomer whose summit of sponsors is empty.
